name: Paper Pencil Drawing & Sketching Class
description:
Welcome to the drawing class, where stick figures are just the beginning, and erasers are your best friend! Whether you’re here to create masterpieces or just make sure your dog doodles don’t look like lumpy potatoes, you’re in the right place. We’ll be tackling everything from drawing straight lines (spoiler: they’re harder than they look) to shading and perspective.
Don’t worry about mistakes—they’re just "happy accidents," and we’ll be making plenty of those. So, grab your pencils, stretch those doodling muscles, and get ready to turn squiggles into art!
